title: Reliable to Expressive: A Curriculum for Rubric-Following Safety Judges
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety judges which are LLMs trained to evaluate model outputs against safety rubrics to identify harmful or malicious content. Since 'safety' in AI context is a codification of ethical boundaries and involves benchmarking whether a model's behavior is 'harmful' or 'safe', it falls under the evaluation of ethics and morality.
